breadcrumb.label: How to Order Books and Payment

intro: Buyers must pay for the books and shipping to the Office of the Royal Society before staff can send the books. Please provide the list of books ordered so that staff can calculate the shipping cost before payment. There are 2 payment methods

sections.heading: Payment methods
list: Pay by postal money order made payable to the Secretary of the Office of the Royal Society, Sanam Suea Pa, Dusit, Bangkok 10300 (Dusit Post Office), enclosing the order details and delivery address with the money order

Pay via Siam Commercial Bank Public Company Limited, account name: Office of the Royal Society (Bookshop), Royal Household Bureau (Sanam Suea Pa) Branch, savings account number 406-347071-9. Fax the proof of transfer with the order details and delivery address to the Bookshop at 0 2356 0492

sections.heading: Further inquiries
sections.html: For further inquiries, contact the Bookshop at 0 2356 0466-70 ext. 1020 or by email ribook@orst.go.th

blocks.title: Information from the former website
blocks.body: The money order address, fax number and telephone numbers on this page are from the previous data set (before the move to the Government Complex, Chaeng Watthana) and are awaiting confirmation by the Office
